News / TradingView / XCF Global Received Notice of Delisting

XCF Global Received Notice of Delisting Less than 1 min read

SAFX On November 18, 2026, Nasdaq notified XCF Global that it would delist the company's common stock after its closing bid price was $0.10 or less for 10 consecutive trading days, triggering Nasdaq Listing Rule 5810(c)(3)(A)(iii). Trading is scheduled to be suspended at the opening of business on November 25, 2026, and Nasdaq plans to file a Form 25-NSE; the company expects the stock to initially trade on the OTC Pink Limited Market under ticker SAFX. Original SEC Filing: XCF Global, Inc. [ SAFX ] - 8-K - Nov. 23, 2026 Disclaimer This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. item.content:encoded:
News / TradingView / BGSF Received Notice of Noncompliance

BGSF Received Notice of Noncompliance Less than 1 min read

BGSF On November 17, 2026, BGSF received notice from the NYSE that it was not meeting Section 802.01B, which requires average market capitalization and stockholders' equity of at least $50 million; its figures were approximately $45.0 million and $46.4 million, respectively. BGSF plans to submit a compliance plan within 45 calendar days, seeking to regain compliance within 18 months. Its stock will continue trading on the NYSE during the cure period, subject to NYSE review and acceptance of the plan. Original SEC Filing: BGSF, INC.
